evidence.reason: Before called metering.initialize() then metering.evaluate(units, 0.1, "monthly"); after calls metering.usageCharge(units, 0.1, "benchmark"), changing both the plan argument and the initialization path.

Right edit rebinds evaluate from usageCharge to usageChargeV2, but subscriptionCharge no longer references evaluate, so the merged behavior of subscriptionCharge is driven by the left edit's direct usageCharge call.
Caller usageQuote still calls evaluate, so the right edit changes usageQuote's behavior while subscriptionCharge's behavior changes independently via the left edit.
Test asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 and evaluate(20, 0.1, "monthly") > 0; the plan string change from "monthly" to "benchmark" is not covered by the supplied tests, leaving behavior uncertain.
